template_data.headline_html: Five things that quietly break your SAM record.

items.title: Annual renewal slips
items.sub: SAM expires every 365 days — payments freeze the moment it lapses

items.title: NAICS codes too narrow
items.sub: If your codes miss your actual services, contracting officers won't find you

items.title: Stale reps & certs
items.sub: Old representations can disqualify a bid before the CO reads another line

items.title: Outdated bank info
items.sub: Changed accounts after registering? Federal payments may land somewhere unexpected

items.title: Forgotten exclusion flag
items.sub: Unresolved compliance issues can flag your record — invisible until a CO checks
